name: e2e-milestone1-closeout
description: Milestone 1 final closeout QA: 6 E2E scenarios, global import boundary, monolithic/stub cleanup verification.

steps.description: Daemon starts with runtime + LocalFS (real node:fs) + GitHubFS mounts, reports correct status.
steps.expect: status.started=true, all 3 mount types accessible, read operations return correct data.

steps.description: Three resource types visible in VFS: host workspace, GitHub snapshot, memory runtime.
steps.expect: All mount points exist in status, stat returns correct types and names.

steps.description: Scan pipeline discovers skills from multiple sources through filter/parser hooks.
steps.expect: Non-skill files filtered, skills parsed with correct metadata, multi-source scan works.

steps.description: discover → enable → disable → re-discover preserves user state.
steps.expect: State transitions correct, upsert preserves state, command handlers return expected data.

steps.description: Startup failure rolls back all plugins; CLI unknown command errors are stable.
steps.expect: dispose called, state reset, error message pattern matches.

steps.description: Double start/stop safe, rescan replaces descriptors idempotently.
steps.expect: No side effects from repeated operations, dispose called exactly once.

steps.description: Three-layer import boundary: sdk/support/plugins closed, catalog isolated, skill-manager isolated.
steps.expect: No reverse dependencies detected across all package boundaries.

steps.description: All previously monolithic packages have multiple modules, stub-only packages have real implementations.
steps.expect: daemon >=5 modules, plugin-sdk >=3 modules, mountfs-host has local-fs.ts.
